method: Street intersections the 2025 art draws, read by eye at 4x on the plate (about +-5 px, at the centre of each drawn road), against OpenStreetMap geometry fetched from api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map on 2026-09-30. Where two named ways share a node, that node; for Tampa Avenue under SR-408 (no shared node), the mean of Tampa's crossings with the two carriageways. Least-squares affine with scripts/georef-map.mjs.

controlPoints.name: W Church St x Tampa Ave (NW)
controlPoints.osm: node shared by West Church Street and Tampa Avenue

controlPoints.name: W Church St x Rio Grande Ave (N)
controlPoints.osm: node shared by West Church Street and Rio Grande Avenue

controlPoints.name: W Anderson St x Nashville Ave (SE)
controlPoints.osm: node shared by West Anderson Street and Nashville Avenue

controlPoints.name: Tampa Ave x SR-408 (SW)
controlPoints.osm: mean of Tampa Avenue's crossings with the two East-West Expressway carriageways

stagesNote: the three stages that carry a GPS anchor (founder ruling 2026-09-30); px are the measured pins in scripts/build-edco-map-2025.mjs
